justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/builder/ResettableClassFileTransformer.java and searched the repo for "ResettableClassFileTransformer.Factory". The target is a small nested interface defined at lines 757-879 with only one method, `make(...)`, and only two in-file implementations (`ForJava9CapableVm` and `ForLegacyVm`) plus a creation action. The only direct uses are internal dispatchers in the same file (`Substitutable.DISPATCHER` at line 468 and `WithCallback.DISPATCHER` at line 669); no external classes reference `ResettableClassFileTransformer.Factory` directly.
